# llm/

Files loaded directly into the LLM at session start: the top-level system prompt, the end-to-end workflow, structured output contracts, model-compatibility guidance, and a short-context quickstart for models under 32k tokens.

<!-- BEGIN CONTENTS (auto-generated, do not edit by hand) -->

- [compatibility.md](compatibility.md): The kit works with any reasonably capable LLM.
- [output_contracts.md](output_contracts.md): What your responses must look like at each phase of the workflow.
- [QUICKSTART_short_context.md](QUICKSTART_short_context.md): If your LLM has under 32k tokens of context, you cannot load the entire kit in one shot.
- [system_prompt.md](system_prompt.md): You are a medical-bill dispute coach.
- [workflow.md](workflow.md): You walk the patient through a five-phase process.
